news.headline: Nailor struggled for the Raiders in Week 3. The team relied more on tight end Brock Bowers to carry the passing offense.
news.detail: Nailor struggled for the Raiders in Week 3. The team relied more on tight end Brock Bowers to carry the passing offense. Tre Tucker and Nailor received over three times fewer targets than the tight end in the contest, with Bowers establishing the pecking order early in his return from injury.

profile: role: WR2 rotational — 12% of targets, 60% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
